276	/-! ## Existence of a conforming numbering -/
277	
278	/-- Owner decision of 2026-11-06 on `StaticsOK`, point (a) (§47, §49 and its last paragraph,
279	§63.2): every declaration conforming to §47 and §49 has a consistent renumbering, a permutation
280	of its identifiers preserving parents, owning statics, kinds, initial states and field order,
281	that satisfies `StaticsOK`. -/
282	theorem StaticsConf.exists_renumber {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsConf statics) :
283	    ∃ σ : List Nat, σ.Perm (List.range statics.length) ∧ ConsistentRenumbering σ statics ∧
284	      StaticsOK (renumber σ statics) := by
285	  let σ := (List.range statics.length).mergeSort (keyLe statics)
286	  have hσ : σ.Perm (List.range statics.length) := List.mergeSort_perm _ _
287	  have hs : σ.Pairwise (fun a b => keyLe statics a b) :=
288	    List.pairwise_mergeSort
289	      (fun a b c hab hbc => by simp only [keyLe, decide_eq_true_eq] at *; omega)
290	      (fun a b => by simp only [keyLe, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) _
291	  have hnd : σ.Nodup := hσ.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
292	  have hown : ∀ x o, staticOwner statics x = some o → odepth statics x = odepth statics o + 1 :=
293	    fun _ _ hxo => chainLen_step h.owner_acyclic h.owner_lt hxo
294	  have hpar : ∀ x p, staticParent statics x = some p → sdepth statics x = sdepth statics p + 1 :=
295	    fun _ _ hxp => chainLen_step h.parent_acyclic h.parent_lt hxp
296	  have hpo : ∀ x p, staticParent statics x = some p → odepth statics x = odepth statics p :=
297	    fun x p hxp => chainLen_congr (h.part_owner x p hxp) _
298	  refine ⟨σ, hσ, ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x y p hx hy hxy => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
299	  · have hix := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx))
300	    simp [renumber, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hix, List.getElem_idxOf hix,
301	      List.getElem?_eq_getElem hx]
302	  · have := hpar x p hx
303	    have := hpar y p hy
304	    have := hpo x p hx
305	    have := hpo y p hy
306	    exact idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs (lt_of_parent hx) (lt_of_parent hy) (by omega)
307	  · unfold StaticsOK ShapeOK
308	    intro i hi
309	    simp only [List.length_map, renumber, List.mem_range] at hi
310	    have hxi : σ[i] < statics.length := List.mem_range.1 (hσ.mem_iff.1 (List.getElem_mem hi))
311	    have hii : σ.idxOf σ[i] = i :=
312	      (List.Nodup.getElem_inj hnd).1 (List.getElem_idxOf (List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem
313	        (List.getElem_mem hi)))
314	    simp only [shape_parent, shape_owner, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.zero_add, renumber_parent hi hxi,
315	      renumber_owner hi hxi]
316	    constructor
317	    · cases hp : staticParent statics σ[i] with
318	      | none => trivial
319	      | some p =>
320	        have hpl := h.parent_lt _ _ hp
321	        have hip := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hpl))
322	        have hpσ : σ[σ.idxOf p] = p := List.getElem_idxOf hip
323	        refine ⟨Nat.zero_le _, ?_, ?_⟩
324	        · have := hpar _ _ hp
325	          have := hpo _ _ hp
326	          have := idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs hpl hxi (by omega)
327	          show σ.idxOf p < i
328	          omega
329	        · show (staticOwner statics σ[i]).map σ.idxOf = staticOwner (renumber σ statics) (σ.idxOf p)
330	          rw [renumber_owner hip (by rw [hpσ]; exact hpl), hpσ, h.part_owner _ _ hp]
331	    · cases ho : staticOwner statics σ[i] with
332	      | none => trivial
333	      | some o =>
334	        have hol := h.owner_lt _ _ ho
335	        have := hown _ _ ho
336	        have := idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs hol hxi (by omega)
337	        exact ⟨Nat.zero_le _, show σ.idxOf o < i by omega⟩

339	/-! ## `StaticsOK` declarations conform -/
340	
341	private theorem rank_of_transGen {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} (rank : Nat → Nat)
342	    (h : ∀ a b, R a b → rank b < rank a) {a b : Nat} (hab : Relation.TransGen R a b) :
343	    rank b < rank a := by
344	  induction hab with
345	  | single hr => exact h _ _ hr
346	  | tail _ hr ih => exact Nat.lt_trans (h _ _ hr) ih
347	
348	/-- `StaticsOK` (§47, §49) is a numbering of a conforming declaration: it implies
349	`StaticsConf`. -/
350	theorem StaticsConf.of_staticsOK {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) :
351	    StaticsConf statics := by
352	  have hok : ∀ i, i < statics.length →
353	      OptP (staticParent statics i)
354	        (fun r => r < i ∧ staticOwner statics i = staticOwner statics r) True ∧
355	      OptP (staticOwner statics i) (fun o => o < i) True := by
356	    intro i hi
357	    have := h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))
358	    simp only [shape_parent, shape_owner, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.zero_add] at this
359	    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := this
360	    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
361	    · cases hp : staticParent statics i with
362	      | none => trivial
363	      | some r =>
364	        rw [hp] at h1
365	        obtain ⟨-, h3, h4⟩ := h1
366	        exact ⟨h3, h4⟩
367	    · cases ho : staticOwner statics i with
368	      | none => trivial
369	      | some o =>
370	        rw [ho] at h2
371	        exact h2.2
372	  have hpar : ∀ a b, staticParent statics a = some b → b < a := fun a b hab => by
373	    have := (hok a (lt_of_parent hab)).1
374	    rw [hab] at this
375	    exact this.1
376	  have hown : ∀ a b, staticOwner statics a = some b → b < a := fun a b hab => by
377	    have := (hok a (lt_of_owner hab)).2
378	    rw [hab] at this
379	    exact this
380	  exact {
381	    parent_lt := fun i p hp => Nat.lt_trans (hpar i p hp) (lt_of_parent hp)
382	    owner_lt := fun i o ho => Nat.lt_trans (hown i o ho) (lt_of_owner ho)
383	    parent_acyclic := fun _ hc => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen id hpar hc)
384	    owner_acyclic := fun _ hc => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen id hown hc)
385	    part_owner := fun i p hp => by
386	      have := (hok i (lt_of_parent hp)).1
387	      rw [hp] at this
388	      exact this.2 }

390	/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §49, §63.2) -/
391	
392	namespace StaticsExamples
393	
394	/-- Static 0 is a part of static 1, declared before it (§49, last paragraph). -/
395	def partFirst : Statics := [((some 1, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 1), false)]
396	
397	/-- `partFirst` is not numbered parent first. -/
398	example : ¬ StaticsOK partFirst := by decide
399	
400	private theorem partFirst_owner : ∀ i, staticOwner partFirst i = none
401	  | 0 | 1 | _ + 2 => rfl
402	
403	/-- `partFirst` conforms to §47 and §49. -/
404	example : StaticsConf partFirst where
405	  parent_lt i p hp := by
406	    rcases i with _ | _ | i <;> simp [staticParent, partFirst] at hp ⊢
407	    omega
408	  owner_lt i o ho := by rw [partFirst_owner] at ho; cases ho
409	  parent_acyclic _ hc := Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen (fun a => if a = 1 then 0 else 1)
410	    (fun a b hab => by
411	      rcases a with _ | _ | a <;> simp [staticParent, partFirst] at hab
412	      subst hab; decide) hc)
413	  owner_acyclic _ hc := Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen (fun _ => 0)
414	    (fun a b hab => by rw [partFirst_owner] at hab; cases hab) hc)
415	  part_owner i p _ := by rw [partFirst_owner, partFirst_owner]
416	
417	/-- Its renumbering by `[1, 0]` satisfies `StaticsOK`. -/
418	example : StaticsOK (renumber [1, 0] partFirst) := by decide
419	
420	/-- Two fields 0 and 1 of static 2, declared before it (§63.2). -/
421	def fieldsFirst : Statics :=
422	  [((some 2, none, 0), true), ((some 2, none, 1), false), ((none, none, 2), false)]
423	
424	/-- Swapping the fields gives a declaration satisfying `StaticsOK`, but not a consistent
425	renumbering: the field order clause is not vacuous (§63.2). -/
426	example : StaticsOK (renumber [2, 1, 0] fieldsFirst) ∧
427	    ¬ ConsistentRenumbering [2, 1, 0] fieldsFirst :=
428	  ⟨by decide, fun h => absurd (h.field_order 0 1 2 rfl rfl (by decide)) (by decide)⟩
429	
430	/-- An ownership cycle does not conform (§47). -/
431	example : ¬ StaticsConf [((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, some 0, 0), true)] :=
432	  fun h => h.owner_acyclic 0 (.tail (.single rfl) rfl)

4	# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability
5	
6	Invariants of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: `WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53),
7	`NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` and `I5` (§57), the declared statics and `S3.init`
8	(§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps
9	O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
10	`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
11	-/
12	
13	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
14	
15	/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/
16	
17	/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
18	def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none
19	
20	/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
21	instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
22	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
23	
24	/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
25	authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
26	def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
27	  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
28	    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
29	      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r
30	
31	/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
32	`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
33	place. -/
34	def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
35	  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
36	    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
37	    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r
38	
39	/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
40	origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
41	def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
42	  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
43	    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner
44	
45	/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/
46	
47	/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
48	acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
49	structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
50	  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
51	  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
52	  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
53	  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
54	  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
55	    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
56	  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
57	  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
58	  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
59	      f < s.nF) ∧
60	    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
61	      o < s.P.length) ∧
62	    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
63	  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
64	  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
65	    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
66	  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
67	  root authority. -/
68	  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
69	  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
70	  rootChain : RootChain s
71	  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
72	  rootHeld : RootHeld s
73	  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
74	  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
75	    HolderLive s y.holder
76	
77	/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/
78	
79	/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
80	both have own mode `Observe`. -/
81	def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
82	  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
83	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
84	    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe
85	
86	/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
87	origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
88	authority is valid, that is, active. -/
89	def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
90	  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
91	    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
92	      (y.active = true → x.active = true)
93	
94	/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
95	def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
96	
97	/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
98	def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
99	  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls
100	
101	/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
102	def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s
103	
104	/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
105	def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
106	  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
107	    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint
108	
109	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
110	def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s
111	
112	/-- `I5` (§57): every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning
113	obligation, §74), belongs to a usable place. The quantifier ranges over the leaves of the state
114	(§40): `K.Pinned` on an index that is not a leaf of `s` is not constrained. A specialized
115	obligation of `K.Pinned`, not a conjunct of the main invariant (§57). -/
116	def I5 (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
117	  ∀ l, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l → (k.Pinned l ∨ s.pin l = true) →
118	    ∃ q, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q
119	
120	/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/
121	
122	/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
123	place holding `b`. -/
124	def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
125	  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
126	    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
127	    | .frame _ => False) False
128	
129	/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
130	def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
131	  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
132	  | _ => True
133	
134	/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
135	authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
136	whole place holding the next. -/
137	def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
138	  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
139	    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
140	      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
141	      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

143	/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/
144	
145	/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
146	initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
147	abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)
148	
149	/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
150	paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
151	parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
152	static (§49.2). -/
153	def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))
154	
155	/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
156	instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
157	  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance
158	
159	/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
160	another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
161	leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
162	dynamic pinning obligation. -/
163	def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
164	  { F := [0]
165	    nF := 1
166	    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
167	    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
168	    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
169	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
170	        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
171	    D := fun _ => []
172	    dead := fun _ => false
173	    pins := [] }
174	
175	/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
176	directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
177	def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
178	  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
179	    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False
180	
181	/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/
182	
183	/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
184	inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
185	  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
186	  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'
187

189	
190	Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
191	`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/

3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: conforming statics declarations and their numbering
5	
6	`StaticsConf` is the conformance of a statics declaration to §47 and §49 with no order between
7	identifiers. `StaticsOK` (`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Invariants`) asks parents and owning statics to
8	be earlier statics; by §49 (last paragraph) this ordering only represents well-formedness. Every
9	conforming declaration has a consistent renumbering satisfying `StaticsOK`
10	(`StaticsConf.exists_renumber`), and every declaration satisfying `StaticsOK` conforms
11	(`StaticsConf.of_staticsOK`).
12	-/
13	
14	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
15	
16	/-! ## Conformance (§40, §47, §49) -/
17	
18	/-- Structural parent of static `i` (§40): `none` for a root static or an index outside the
19	declaration. -/
20	def staticParent (statics : Statics) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (statics[i]?).bind (·.1.1)
21	
22	/-- Owning static of static `i` (§40, §47): `none` for a static owned by frame 0 or an index
23	outside the declaration. -/
24	def staticOwner (statics : Statics) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (statics[i]?).bind (·.1.2.1)
25	
26	/-- Conformance of a statics declaration to §47 and §49, with no order between identifiers
27	(§49, last paragraph). Owners are frame 0 or a static (§40, §47), parents and owning statics are
28	declared statics (§49.2, §49.3), composition links are acyclic (§49.2), no static is owned,
29	directly or transitively, by itself (§47), and every structural part has its parent's owner
30	(§49.2, §40).
31	
32	Acyclicity is the irreflexivity of the transitive closure `Relation.TransGen` of the one-step
33	link (`a`'s parent, resp. owning static, is `b`): `TransGen link i i` holds exactly when a
34	nonempty chain of links leads from `i` back to `i`, which is what §47 ("owned, directly or
35	transitively, by itself") and §49.2 (acyclic composition links) exclude. No bound on chain
36	length is involved. -/
37	structure StaticsConf (statics : Statics) : Prop where
38	  /-- §49.2: composition links are valid; every structural parent is a declared static. -/
39	  parent_lt : ∀ i p, staticParent statics i = some p → p < statics.length
40	  /-- §49.3, §47: owners are valid; every owning static is a declared static. -/
41	  owner_lt : ∀ i o, staticOwner statics i = some o → o < statics.length
42	  /-- §49.2: composition links are acyclic; no static is its own strict structural ancestor. -/
43	  parent_acyclic : ∀ i, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => staticParent statics a = some b) i i
44	  /-- §47: no static is owned, directly or transitively, by itself. -/
45	  owner_acyclic : ∀ i, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => staticOwner statics a = some b) i i
46	  /-- §49.2, §40: every structural part shares its parent's owner. -/
47	  part_owner : ∀ i p, staticParent statics i = some p →
48	    staticOwner statics i = staticOwner statics p
49	
50	/-! ## Renumbering (§49, last paragraph; §63.2) -/
51	
52	/-- A static's entry with its references, parent and owning static, mapped through `τ`; its
53	kind and initial state are kept (§49, last paragraph). -/
54	def mapRefs (τ : Nat → Nat) (e : (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool) :
55	    (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool :=
56	  ((e.1.1.map τ, e.1.2.1.map τ, e.1.2.2), e.2)
57	
58	/-- Renumbering of a declaration by `σ` (§49, last paragraph): new index `i` holds old static
59	`σ[i]`, its parent and owning static mapped through the inverse `σ.idxOf`. Meant for `σ` a
60	permutation of `List.range statics.length`. -/
61	def renumber (σ : List Nat) (statics : Statics) : Statics :=
62	  σ.map fun j => mapRefs σ.idxOf ((statics[j]?).getD ((none, none, 0), false))
63	
64	/-- Consistent renumbering (§49, last paragraph; §63.2): the new index `σ.idxOf x` of every old
65	static `x` holds `x` with its parent and owning static mapped through `σ.idxOf`, and its kind and
66	initial state; the parts of every place keep their relative order, which is their positional
67	field order (§63.2; `kids` orders the parts of a place by index). -/
68	structure ConsistentRenumbering (σ : List Nat) (statics : Statics) : Prop where
69	  /-- Parents to parents, owning statics to owning statics, same kind and initial state. -/
70	  entry : ∀ x < statics.length,
71	    (renumber σ statics)[σ.idxOf x]? = (statics[x]?).map (mapRefs σ.idxOf)
72	  /-- §63.2: the field order of every place is preserved. -/
73	  field_order : ∀ x y p, staticParent statics x = some p → staticParent statics y = some p →
74	    x < y → σ.idxOf x < σ.idxOf y
75	
76	/-! ## Proof support: chains of a partial link -/
77	
78	/-- Pigeonhole: a duplicate-free list of numbers below `n` has at most `n` elements. -/
79	private theorem nodup_length_le : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Nat), l.Nodup → (∀ a ∈ l, a < n) →
80	    l.length ≤ n
81	  | 0, [], _, _ => Nat.le_refl _
82	  | 0, a :: _, _, h => absurd (h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)) (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
83	  | n + 1, l, hd, h => by
84	    have := nodup_length_le n (l.erase n) (hd.erase n) fun a ha => by
85	      rw [hd.mem_erase_iff] at ha
86	      have := h a ha.2
87	      omega
88	    rw [List.length_erase] at this
89	    split at this <;> omega
90	
91	/-- `k` links `f` from `x`. -/
92	private def iter (f : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
93	  | 0, x => some x
94	  | k + 1, x => (iter f k x).bind f
95	
96	private theorem iter_add (f : Nat → Option Nat) (x i : Nat) : ∀ d,
97	    iter f (i + d) x = (iter f i x).bind (iter f d)
98	  | 0 => by
99	    show iter f i x = _
100	    cases iter f i x <;> rfl
101	  | d + 1 => by
102	    show (iter f (i + d) x).bind f = _
103	    rw [iter_add f x i d, Option.bind_assoc]
104	    rfl
105	
106	private theorem transGen_of_iter {f : Nat → Option Nat} {x : Nat} : ∀ {k y : Nat},
107	    iter f (k + 1) x = some y → Relation.TransGen (fun a b => f a = some b) x y
108	  | 0, _, h => .single h
109	  | k + 1, _, h => by
110	    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcy⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.1 h
111	    exact .tail (transGen_of_iter hc) hcy
112	
113	/-- An acyclic partial link whose targets are below `n` has chains of fewer than `n` links from
114	any `x < n`. -/
115	private theorem iter_bound {f : Nat → Option Nat} {n : Nat}
116	    (hacyc : ∀ a, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => f a = some b) a a)
117	    (hlt : ∀ a b, f a = some b → b < n) {x : Nat} (hx : x < n) {k : Nat}
118	    (hk : (iter f k x).isSome) : k < n := by
119	  let g := fun i => (iter f i x).getD 0
120	  have hsome : ∀ i ≤ k, iter f i x = some (g i) := by
121	    intro i hi
122	    have := iter_add f x i (k - i)
123	    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hi] at this
124	    cases hc : iter f i x with
125	    | none => rw [hc] at this; rw [this] at hk; simp at hk
126	    | some c => simp [g, hc]
127	  have hlt' : ∀ a ∈ (List.range (k + 1)).map g, a < n := by
128	    intro a ha
129	    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ha
130	    have hi' := hsome i (by rw [List.mem_range] at hi; omega)
131	    cases i with
132	    | zero => simp only [iter, Option.some.injEq] at hi'; omega
133	    | succ j =>
134	      obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.1 hi'
135	      exact hlt c _ hc
136	  have hnd : ((List.range (k + 1)).map g).Nodup := by
137	    unfold List.Nodup
138	    rw [List.pairwise_map]
139	    refine List.pairwise_lt_range.imp_of_mem fun {i j} hi hj hij heq => ?_
140	    rw [List.mem_range] at hi hj
141	    have hj' := iter_add f x i (j - i)
142	    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' (Nat.le_of_lt hij), hsome i (by omega), hsome j (by omega), heq,
143	      Option.bind_some] at hj'
144	    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, j - i = d + 1 := ⟨j - i - 1, by omega⟩
145	    rw [hd] at hj'
146	    exact hacyc _ (transGen_of_iter hj'.symm)
147	  have := nodup_length_le n _ hnd hlt'
148	  simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range] at this
149	  omega
150	
151	/-- Length of the chain of links `f` from `x`, cut at `k` links. -/
152	private def chainLen (f : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
153	  | 0, _ => 0
154	  | k + 1, x => match f x with
155	    | none => 0
156	    | some y => chainLen f k y + 1
157	
158	private theorem chainLen_some {f : Nat → Option Nat} {k x y : Nat} (h : f x = some y) :
159	    chainLen f (k + 1) x = chainLen f k y + 1 := by
160	  show (match f x with | none => 0 | some y => chainLen f k y + 1) = _
161	  rw [h]
162	
163	private theorem chainLen_congr {f : Nat → Option Nat} {x y : Nat} (h : f x = f y) :
164	    ∀ k, chainLen f k x = chainLen f k y
165	  | 0 => rfl
166	  | _ + 1 => by simp only [chainLen, h]
167	
168	private theorem iter_of_chainLen_ne {f : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ {k z : Nat},
169	    chainLen f (k + 1) z ≠ chainLen f k z → (iter f (k + 1) z).isSome
170	  | 0, z, h => by
171	    cases hz : f z with
172	    | none => simp [chainLen, hz] at h
173	    | some y => simp [iter, hz]
174	  | k + 1, z, h => by
175	    cases hz : f z with
176	    | none => simp [chainLen, hz] at h
177	    | some y =>
178	      rw [chainLen_some hz, chainLen_some hz] at h
179	      have := iter_add f z 1 (k + 1)
180	      rw [Nat.add_comm 1] at this
181	      rw [this]
182	      simp only [iter, Option.bind_some, hz]
183	      exact iter_of_chainLen_ne (by omega)
184	
185	/-- Under an acyclic link with targets below `n`, the chain length cut at `n` grows by one along
186	each link. -/
187	private theorem chainLen_step {f : Nat → Option Nat} {n : Nat}
188	    (hacyc : ∀ a, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => f a = some b) a a)
189	    (hlt : ∀ a b, f a = some b → b < n) {x y : Nat} (h : f x = some y) :
190	    chainLen f n x = chainLen f n y + 1 := by
191	  have hy := hlt x y h
192	  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
193	  rw [chainLen_some h]
194	  refine congrArg (· + 1) (Classical.byContradiction fun hne => ?_)
195	  have := iter_bound hacyc hlt hy (iter_of_chainLen_ne (k := m) (fun e => hne e.symm))
196	  omega

198	/-! ## Proof support: the order of a conforming declaration -/
199	
200	/-- Ownership depth of a static. -/
201	private def odepth (statics : Statics) (x : Nat) : Nat :=
202	  chainLen (staticOwner statics) statics.length x
203	
204	/-- Structural depth of a static. -/
205	private def sdepth (statics : Statics) (x : Nat) : Nat :=
206	  chainLen (staticParent statics) statics.length x
207	
208	/-- Lexicographic order on (ownership depth, structural depth, index). -/
209	private def keyLe (statics : Statics) (a b : Nat) : Bool :=
210	  decide (odepth statics a < odepth statics b ∨ odepth statics a = odepth statics b ∧
211	    (sdepth statics a < sdepth statics b ∨ sdepth statics a = sdepth statics b ∧ a ≤ b))
212	
213	private theorem idxOf_lt_of_key {statics : Statics} {σ : List Nat}
214	    (hσ : σ.Perm (List.range statics.length)) (hs : σ.Pairwise (fun a b => keyLe statics a b))
215	    {x y : Nat} (hx : x < statics.length) (hy : y < statics.length)
216	    (hk : odepth statics x < odepth statics y ∨ odepth statics x = odepth statics y ∧
217	      (sdepth statics x < sdepth statics y ∨ sdepth statics x = sdepth statics y ∧ x < y)) :
218	    σ.idxOf x < σ.idxOf y := by
219	  have hix := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx))
220	  have hiy := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hy))
221	  have gx := List.getElem_idxOf hix
222	  have gy := List.getElem_idxOf hiy
223	  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy (σ.idxOf x) (σ.idxOf y) with h | h | h
224	  · exact h
225	  · have : x = y := by
226	      rw [← gx, ← gy]
227	      exact getElem_congr rfl h hix
228	    subst this
229	    omega
230	  · have := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.1 hs _ _ hiy hix h
231	    rw [gx, gy] at this
232	    simp only [keyLe, decide_eq_true_eq] at this
233	    omega

239	  | none => rw [hx] at h; cases h

243	    (h : staticOwner statics x = some o) : x < statics.length := by
244	  unfold staticOwner at h

246	  | none => rw [hx] at h; cases h
247	  | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1

250	    ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1) = staticParent statics i := by

261	    (renumber σ statics)[i]? = some (mapRefs σ.idxOf statics[σ[i]]) := by

278	/-- Owner decision of 2026-11-06 on `StaticsOK`, point (a) (§47, §49 and its last paragraph,
279	§63.2): every declaration conforming to §47 and §49 has a consistent renumbering, a permutation
280	of its identifiers preserving parents, owning statics, kinds, initial states and field order,
281	that satisfies `StaticsOK`. -/

283	    ∃ σ : List Nat, σ.Perm (List.range statics.length) ∧ ConsistentRenumbering σ statics ∧
284	      StaticsOK (renumber σ statics) := by
285	  let σ := (List.range statics.length).mergeSort (keyLe statics)
286	  have hσ : σ.Perm (List.range statics.length) := List.mergeSort_perm _ _
287	  have hs : σ.Pairwise (fun a b => keyLe statics a b) :=
288	    List.pairwise_mergeSort
289	      (fun a b c hab hbc => by simp only [keyLe, decide_eq_true_eq] at *; omega)
290	      (fun a b => by simp only [keyLe, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) _
291	  have hnd : σ.Nodup := hσ.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
292	  have hown : ∀ x o, staticOwner statics x = some o → odepth statics x = odepth statics o + 1 :=
293	    fun _ _ hxo => chainLen_step h.owner_acyclic h.owner_lt hxo
294	  have hpar : ∀ x p, staticParent statics x = some p → sdepth statics x = sdepth statics p + 1 :=
295	    fun _ _ hxp => chainLen_step h.parent_acyclic h.parent_lt hxp
296	  have hpo : ∀ x p, staticParent statics x = some p → odepth statics x = odepth statics p :=
297	    fun x p hxp => chainLen_congr (h.part_owner x p hxp) _
298	  refine ⟨σ, hσ, ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x y p hx hy hxy => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
299	  · have hix := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx))
300	    simp [renumber, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hix, List.getElem_idxOf hix,
301	      List.getElem?_eq_getElem hx]
302	  · have := hpar x p hx
303	    have := hpar y p hy
304	    have := hpo x p hx
305	    have := hpo y p hy
306	    exact idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs (lt_of_parent hx) (lt_of_parent hy) (by omega)
307	  · unfold StaticsOK ShapeOK
308	    intro i hi
309	    simp only [List.length_map, renumber, List.mem_range] at hi
310	    have hxi : σ[i] < statics.length := List.mem_range.1 (hσ.mem_iff.1 (List.getElem_mem hi))
311	    have hii : σ.idxOf σ[i] = i :=
312	      (List.Nodup.getElem_inj hnd).1 (List.getElem_idxOf (List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem
313	        (List.getElem_mem hi)))
314	    simp only [shape_parent, shape_owner, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.zero_add, renumber_parent hi hxi,
315	      renumber_owner hi hxi]
316	    constructor
317	    · cases hp : staticParent statics σ[i] with
318	      | none => trivial
319	      | some p =>
320	        have hpl := h.parent_lt _ _ hp
321	        have hip := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hpl))
322	        have hpσ : σ[σ.idxOf p] = p := List.getElem_idxOf hip
323	        refine ⟨Nat.zero_le _, ?_, ?_⟩
324	        · have := hpar _ _ hp
325	          have := hpo _ _ hp
326	          have := idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs hpl hxi (by omega)
327	          show σ.idxOf p < i
328	          omega
329	        · show (staticOwner statics σ[i]).map σ.idxOf = staticOwner (renumber σ statics) (σ.idxOf p)
330	          rw [renumber_owner hip (by rw [hpσ]; exact hpl), hpσ, h.part_owner _ _ hp]
331	    · cases ho : staticOwner statics σ[i] with
332	      | none => trivial
333	      | some o =>
334	        have hol := h.owner_lt _ _ ho
335	        have := hown _ _ ho

341	private theorem rank_of_transGen {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} (rank : Nat → Nat)
342	    (h : ∀ a b, R a b → rank b < rank a) {a b : Nat} (hab : Relation.TransGen R a b) :
343	    rank b < rank a := by
344	  induction hab with
345	  | single hr => exact h _ _ hr
346	  | tail _ hr ih => exact Nat.lt_trans (h _ _ hr) ih
347	
348	/-- `StaticsOK` (§47, §49) is a numbering of a conforming declaration: it implies
349	`StaticsConf`. -/
350	theorem StaticsConf.of_staticsOK {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) :
351	    StaticsConf statics := by
352	  have hok : ∀ i, i < statics.length →
353	      OptP (staticParent statics i)
354	        (fun r => r < i ∧ staticOwner statics i = staticOwner statics r) True ∧
355	      OptP (staticOwner statics i) (fun o => o < i) True := by
356	    intro i hi
357	    have := h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))
358	    simp only [shape_parent, shape_owner, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.zero_add] at this
359	    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := this
360	    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
361	    · cases hp : staticParent statics i with
362	      | none => trivial
363	      | some r =>
364	        rw [hp] at h1
365	        obtain ⟨-, h3, h4⟩ := h1
366	        exact ⟨h3, h4⟩
367	    · cases ho : staticOwner statics i with
368	      | none => trivial
369	      | some o =>
370	        rw [ho] at h2
371	        exact h2.2
372	  have hpar : ∀ a b, staticParent statics a = some b → b < a := fun a b hab => by
373	    have := (hok a (lt_of_parent hab)).1
374	    rw [hab] at this
375	    exact this.1
376	  have hown : ∀ a b, staticOwner statics a = some b → b < a := fun a b hab => by
377	    have := (hok a (lt_of_owner hab)).2
378	    rw [hab] at this
379	    exact this
380	  exact {
381	    parent_lt := fun i p hp => Nat.lt_trans (hpar i p hp) (lt_of_parent hp)
382	    owner_lt := fun i o ho => Nat.lt_trans (hown i o ho) (lt_of_owner ho)
383	    parent_acyclic := fun _ hc => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen id hpar hc)
384	    owner_acyclic := fun _ hc => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen id hown hc)
385	    part_owner := fun i p hp => by
386	      have := (hok i (lt_of_parent hp)).1
387	      rw [hp] at this
388	      exact this.2 }

391	
392	namespace StaticsExamples
393	
394	/-- Static 0 is a part of static 1, declared before it (§49, last paragraph). -/
395	def partFirst : Statics := [((some 1, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 1), false)]
396	
397	/-- `partFirst` is not numbered parent first. -/
398	example : ¬ StaticsOK partFirst := by decide
399	
400	private theorem partFirst_owner : ∀ i, staticOwner partFirst i = none
401	  | 0 | 1 | _ + 2 => rfl
402	
403	/-- `partFirst` conforms to §47 and §49. -/
404	example : StaticsConf partFirst where
405	  parent_lt i p hp := by
406	    rcases i with _ | _ | i <;> simp [staticParent, partFirst] at hp ⊢
407	    omega
408	  owner_lt i o ho := by rw [partFirst_owner] at ho; cases ho
409	  parent_acyclic _ hc := Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen (fun a => if a = 1 then 0 else 1)
410	    (fun a b hab => by
411	      rcases a with _ | _ | a <;> simp [staticParent, partFirst] at hab
412	      subst hab; decide) hc)
413	  owner_acyclic _ hc := Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen (fun _ => 0)
414	    (fun a b hab => by rw [partFirst_owner] at hab; cases hab) hc)
415	  part_owner i p _ := by rw [partFirst_owner, partFirst_owner]

4	# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability
5	
6	Invariants of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: `WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53),
7	`NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` and `I5` (§57), the declared statics and `S3.init`
8	(§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps
9	O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
10	`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
11	-/
12	
13	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
14	
15	/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/
16	
17	/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
18	def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none
19	
20	/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
21	instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
22	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
23	
24	/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
25	authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
26	def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
27	  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
28	    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
29	      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r
30	
31	/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
32	`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
33	place. -/
34	def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
35	  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
36	    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
37	    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r
38	
39	/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
40	origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
41	def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
42	  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
43	    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner
44	
45	/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/
46	
47	/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
48	acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
49	structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
50	  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
51	  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
52	  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
53	  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
54	  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
55	    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
56	  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
57	  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
58	  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
59	      f < s.nF) ∧
60	    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
61	      o < s.P.length) ∧
62	    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
63	  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
64	  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
65	    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
66	  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
67	  root authority. -/
68	  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
69	  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
70	  rootChain : RootChain s
71	  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
72	  rootHeld : RootHeld s
73	  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
74	  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
75	    HolderLive s y.holder
76	
77	/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/
78	
79	/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
80	both have own mode `Observe`. -/
81	def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
82	  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
83	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
84	    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe
85	
86	/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
87	origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
88	authority is valid, that is, active. -/
89	def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
90	  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
91	    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
92	      (y.active = true → x.active = true)
93	
94	/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
95	def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
96	
97	/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
98	def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
99	  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls
100	
101	/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
102	def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s
103	
104	/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
105	def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
106	  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
107	    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint
108	
109	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
110	def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s
111	
112	/-- `I5` (§57): every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning
113	obligation, §74), belongs to a usable place. The quantifier ranges over the leaves of the state
114	(§40): `K.Pinned` on an index that is not a leaf of `s` is not constrained. A specialized
115	obligation of `K.Pinned`, not a conjunct of the main invariant (§57). -/
116	def I5 (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
117	  ∀ l, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l → (k.Pinned l ∨ s.pin l = true) →
118	    ∃ q, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q
119	
120	/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/
121	
122	/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
123	place holding `b`. -/
124	def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
125	  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
126	    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
127	    | .frame _ => False) False
128	
129	/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
130	def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
131	  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
132	  | _ => True
133	
134	/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
135	authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
136	whole place holding the next. -/
137	def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
138	  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
139	    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
140	      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
141	      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)
142	
143	/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/
144	
145	/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
146	initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
147	abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)
148	
149	/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
150	paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
151	parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
152	static (§49.2). -/
153	def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))
154	
155	/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
156	instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
157	  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance
158	
159	/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
160	another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
161	leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
162	dynamic pinning obligation. -/
163	def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
164	  { F := [0]
165	    nF := 1
166	    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
167	    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
168	    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
169	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,

171	    D := fun _ => []

def ancestor (F : Frames) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop := f₁ ∈ F.dropWhile (· != f₂)

/-- Decidability of `ancestor` (§39). -/
instance (F : Frames) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (ancestor F f₁ f₂) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∈ _))

/-! ## Parent chains (§40, §42) -/

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along the link `org`, nearest first, within fuel `k` (§40 structural
parents, §42 origins). Only links to a smaller index are followed (§49, last paragraph). -/
def chainF (org : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → List Nat
  | 0, _ => []
  | k + 1, i =>
    match org i with
    | some o => if o < i then o :: chainF org k o else []
    | none => []

/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along `org` (§40, §42); fuel `i` suffices since the chain
decreases. -/
def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i

/-! ## Places, leaves, footprints (§40) -/

/-- Holder of an authority (§42) or owner of a place (§40): a frame or a place. -/
inductive Holder where
  | frame (f : Nat)
  | place (p : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Logical place (§40): optional structural parent, owner, abstract `kind`. Its identity is its
index in `P`; its death marker is `S3.dead`. -/
structure Place where
  parent : Option Nat
  owner : Holder
  kind : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Structural parent of place `i` (§40). -/
def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)

/-- `partOf(p, q)` (§40): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` or one of its structural
ancestors. -/
def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)

/-- Decidability of `partOf` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- Leaf (§40): a place with no structural child. -/
def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l

/-- Decidability of `isLeaf` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))

/-- `footprint(q)` (§40): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)

/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (§63.3). -/
def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q

/-- Decidability of `overlap` (§63.3). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- `OwnedIn P src q` (§40, §33): the ownership chain of `q` reaches a place owned by `src` or by
one of its parts, that is, `q` is storage owned, directly or transitively, by the value at
`src`. -/
inductive OwnedIn (P : List Place) (src : Nat) : Nat → Prop where
  | direct {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → partOf P o src →
      OwnedIn P src q
  | step {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → OwnedIn P src o →
      OwnedIn P src q

/-! ## State (§38, §41, §42) -/

/-- Initialization state of a leaf (§41). -/
inductive InitSt where
  | uninit
  | init
  | moved
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Mode of an authority or of a request (§42, §43). -/
inductive Mode where
  | observe
  | modify
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Order of requested modes, `Observe ≤ Modify` (§43). -/
def Mode.le (m m' : Mode) : Prop := m = .observe ∨ m' = .modify

/-- Decidability of the mode order (§43). -/
instance (m m' : Mode) : Decidable (m.le m') := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∨ _))

/-- Authority (§42): own mode, optional origin, footprint (a list of leaves read
extensionally), holder, activity. Its identity is its index in `A`. -/
structure Authority where
  mode : Mode
  origin : Option Nat
  footprint : List Nat
  holder : Holder
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Dynamic pinning obligation (§74, §75): the place `pin` was applied to, the leaves it pins, and
whether it is still active. Its identity is its index in `S3.pins`. -/
structure PinOb where
  place : Nat
  leaves : List Nat
  active : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State `S3` (§38). `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D` are the components of §38. `nF` (next fresh frame
identity, §39), `dead` (death marker of places, §40) and `pins` (dynamic pinning obligations,
§74, §75) are auxiliary information that creates no right (§38). -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l

/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
receiving the shape. -/
abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
  Pinned : Nat → Prop
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop

/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)

/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i

/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x

/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true

/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
  match h : s.A[x]? with
  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'

/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

/-! ## Decidable helpers -/

/-- Predicate on an optional value, `P y` for `some y` and `d` for `none`; used to read the
components of `S3` (§38). -/
def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | some y => P y
  | none => d

/-- Decidability of `OptP` (§38). -/
instance {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) [DecidablePred P] [Decidable d] :
    Decidable (OptP o P d) :=
  match o with
  | some y => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (P y))
  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable d)
----
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/

/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/
def LocalShape.toShape (ls : LocalShape) : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
  ls.map fun e => (e.1, none, e.2)

/-- Owner of element `i` of a shape (§47, §72, §71): its owning element if any, `hd`
otherwise. -/
def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
  | some o => .place o
  | none => hd

/-- Places `P` followed by the elements of a shape (§47, §71, §72): (parent, owning element,
kind), owned by their owning element or by `hd`. -/
def shapeP (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    List Place :=
  P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (§72.2, §71.1; for statics, the hypothesis recorded for
§47): the parent and the owning element of an element are earlier elements, and a part has the
owning element of its parent. -/
def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True

/-- Decidability of `ShapeOK` (§72.2, §71.1). -/
instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance

/-- Indices of the root elements (no parent) of a shape (§40 root places; §47, §71, §72). -/
def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (§72) -/

/-- Places after `enterFrame` (§72, `ok` effect): the locals appended, owned by the new frame. -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place := shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls.toShape

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Renaming of identities: core definitions

Foundation of the renaming bisimulation of the access kernel for
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §49, last paragraph: renamings of place and
authority identities (`Ren`), the relation they induce on places, authorities, pinning
obligations (§74, §75) and states (§38), the order facts carried along runs (`Down`, `SibMono`),
the renamed contract (§48, §80), the renamed operations (§60–§75), and the relation of outcomes
(§58). Generic lemmas on these relations, closed by symmetry.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Rename

/-! ## Renamings (§49, last paragraph) -/

/-- A renaming of identities (§49, last paragraph): a bijection of `Nat` with its inverse. -/
structure Ren where
  f : Nat → Nat
  g : Nat → Nat
  gf : ∀ i, g (f i) = i
  fg : ∀ i, f (g i) = i

/-- The identity renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
def Ren.id : Ren := ⟨fun i => i, fun i => i, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩

/-- The inverse renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
def Ren.symm (π : Ren) : Ren := ⟨π.g, π.f, π.fg, π.gf⟩

/-- Composition of renamings, `π` first (§49, last paragraph). -/
def Ren.comp (π' π : Ren) : Ren :=
  ⟨fun i => π'.f (π.f i), fun i => π.g (π'.g i), fun i => by simp [π'.gf, π.gf],
   fun i => by simp [π'.fg, π.fg]⟩

/-- Renaming of a permutation `τ` of `List.range n` (§49, last paragraph): old `x < n` goes to its
position in `τ`, new `i < n` comes from `τ[i]`; identity from `n` on. -/
def Ren.ofPerm (τ : List Nat) (n : Nat) (h : τ.Perm (List.range n)) : Ren where
  f x := if x < n then τ.idxOf x else x
  g i := if hi : i < τ.length then τ[i] else i
  gf x := by
    have hl : τ.length = n := by simpa using h.length_eq
    by_cases hx : x < n
    · have hm : x ∈ τ := h.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx)
      have hi := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hm
      simp [hx, hi, List.getElem_idxOf hi]
    · simp [hx, hl]
  fg i := by
    have hl : τ.length = n := by simpa using h.length_eq
    have hnd : τ.Nodup := h.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
    by_cases hi : i < τ.length
    · have hlt : τ[i] < n := List.mem_range.1 (h.mem_iff.1 (List.getElem_mem hi))
      simp only [hi, dite_true, hlt, ite_true]
      exact (List.Nodup.getElem_inj hnd).1
        (List.getElem_idxOf (List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (List.getElem_mem hi)))
    · simp [hi, hl ▸ hi]

/-- The inverse of `π` maps forward by `π.g` (§49, last paragraph). -/
@[simp] theorem Ren.symm_f (π : Ren) (i : Nat) : π.symm.f i = π.g i := rfl

/-- The inverse of `π` maps backward by `π.f` (§49, last paragraph). -/
@[simp] theorem Ren.symm_g (π : Ren) (i : Nat) : π.symm.g i = π.f i := rfl

/-- The inverse of the inverse is the renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.symm_symm (π : Ren) : π.symm.symm = π := rfl

/-- A renaming is injective (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.f_inj (π : Ren) {i j : Nat} : π.f i = π.f j ↔ i = j :=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← π.gf i, h, π.gf], fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩

/-- A renaming is determined by its forward map (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.ext {π π' : Ren} (h : ∀ i, π.f i = π'.f i) : π = π' := by
  have hg : ∀ i, π.g i = π'.g i := fun i =>
    calc π.g i = π.g (π.f (π'.g i)) := by rw [h, π'.fg]
      _ = π'.g i := π.gf _
  obtain ⟨f, g, _, _⟩ := π
  obtain ⟨f', g', _, _⟩ := π'
  simp only [Ren.mk.injEq]
  exact ⟨funext h, funext hg⟩

/-- A renaming composed with its inverse is the identity (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.symm_comp (π : Ren) : π.symm.comp π = Ren.id := Ren.ext fun i => π.gf i

/-- Mapping by `π.f` then `π.g` is the identity on lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.map_gf (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) : (l.map π.f).map π.g = l := by
  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.gf]

/-- Mapping by `π.g` then `π.f` is the identity on lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.map_fg (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) : (l.map π.g).map π.f = l := by
  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.fg]

/-- Membership in a renamed list, read backward (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.mem_map (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) (y : Nat) : y ∈ l.map π.f ↔ π.g y ∈ l := by
  constructor
  · intro hy; obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; rwa [π.gf]
  · intro hy; exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨π.g y, hy, π.fg y⟩

/-- Membership of a renamed identity in a renamed list (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.mem_map_f (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) (x : Nat) : π.f x ∈ l.map π.f ↔ x ∈ l := by
  rw [π.mem_map, π.gf]

/-- The f-form of a membership correspondence gives its g-form (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.mem_iff_g (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (h : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L) (y : Nat) :
    y ∈ L' ↔ π.g y ∈ L := by rw [← h, π.fg]

/-- Universal quantification over all identities, renamed (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.forall_iff (π : Ren) {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
    (∀ y, Q' y) ↔ ∀ x, Q x :=
  ⟨fun h x => (hQ x).1 (h _), fun h y => by rw [← π.fg y]; exact (hQ _).2 (h _)⟩

/-- Universal quantification over corresponding lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.forall_mem_iff (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hL : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L)
    {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
    (∀ y ∈ L', Q' y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ L, Q x :=
  ⟨fun h x hx => (hQ x).1 (h _ ((hL x).2 hx)),
   fun h y hy => by
    rw [← π.fg y] at hy ⊢; exact (hQ _).2 (h _ ((hL _).1 hy))⟩

/-- Existential quantification over corresponding lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.exists_mem_iff (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hL : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L)
    {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
    (∃ y ∈ L', Q' y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ L, Q x :=
  ⟨fun ⟨y, hy, hq⟩ => by
    rw [← π.fg y] at hy hq; exact ⟨_, (hL _).1 hy, (hQ _).1 hq⟩,
   fun ⟨x, hx, hq⟩ => ⟨_, (hL x).2 hx, (hQ x).2 hq⟩⟩

/-- Duplicate-free lists with corresponding members are permutations up to renaming (§42: sets
represented by lists; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.perm_of_mem (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hnd : L.Nodup) (hnd' : L'.Nodup)
    (h : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L) : L'.Perm (L.map π.f) := by
  have hm : (L.map π.f).Nodup :=
    List.pairwise_map.2 (hnd.imp fun hab e => hab ((Ren.f_inj π).1 e))
  refine (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hnd' hm).2 fun y => ?_
  rw [π.mem_iff_g h, π.mem_map]

/-- A duplicate-free list of `n` identities below `n` is a permutation of `List.range n` (§49,
last paragraph). -/
theorem perm_range_of_nodup {l : List Nat} {n : Nat} (hnd : l.Nodup) (hlt : ∀ a ∈ l, a < n)
    (hlen : l.length = n) : l.Perm (List.range n) := by
  refine (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hnd List.nodup_range).2 fun a =>
    ⟨fun ha => List.mem_range.2 (hlt a ha), fun ha => ?_⟩
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hna => ?_
  have hsub : l ⊆ (List.range n).erase a := fun b hb =>
    (List.mem_erase_of_ne (fun e => hna (by subst e; exact hb))).2 (List.mem_range.2 (hlt b hb))
  have := List.Nodup.length_le_of_subset hnd hsub
  rw [List.length_erase_of_mem ha, List.length_range] at this
  have : 0 < n := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) (List.mem_range.1 ha)
  omega

/-- `flatMap` of pointwise permutations is a permutation (§44: `D(p)` is a set; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem perm_flatMap_pointwise {α β : Type} {f g : α → List β} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a ∈ l, (f a).Perm (g a)) → (l.flatMap f).Perm (l.flatMap g)
  | [], _ => .nil
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons]
    exact (h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)).append
      (perm_flatMap_pointwise fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb))

/-- Positions are kept by an injective map (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem posIn_map {f : Nat → Nat} (hf : ∀ i j, f i = f j → i = j) (r : Nat) :
    ∀ l : List Nat, posIn (f r) (l.map f) = posIn r l
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, posIn, posIn_map hf r l]
    by_cases h : a = r
    · subst h; simp
    · have : f a ≠ f r := fun e => h (hf _ _ e)
      simp [h, this]

/-- Two strictly sorted lists with the same members are equal (§63.2: children in index order;
§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem eq_of_sorted_mem {l l' : List Nat} (h : l.Pairwise (· < ·)) (h' : l'.Pairwise (· < ·))
    (hm : ∀ a, a ∈ l ↔ a ∈ l') : l = l' :=
  List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise (le := (· < ·))
    (fun _ _ _ _ hab hba => absurd (Nat.lt_trans hab hba) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)) h h'
    ((List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup (h.imp Nat.ne_of_lt) (h'.imp Nat.ne_of_lt)).2 hm)

/-- A related `some` has a related `some` (§38: components read by index; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem optionRel_some {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {o : Option α} {o' : Option β} {a : α}
    (h : Option.Rel r o o') (ha : o = some a) : ∃ b, o' = some b ∧ r a b := by
  subst ha; cases h with | some h => exact ⟨_, rfl, h⟩

/-- A related `some`, read backward (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem optionRel_some' {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {o : Option α} {o' : Option β} {b : β}
    (h : Option.Rel r o o') (hb : o' = some b) : ∃ a, o = some a ∧ r a b := by
  subst hb; cases h with | some h => exact ⟨_, rfl, h⟩

/-- Related options are `none` together (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem optionRel_none_iff {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {o : Option α} {o' : Option β}
    (h : Option.Rel r o o') : o = none ↔ o' = none := by
  cases h <;> simp

/-- Symmetry of `Option.Rel` (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem optionRel_symm {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {r' : β → α → Prop}
    (hr : ∀ a b, r a b → r' b a) : ∀ {o o'}, Option.Rel r o o' → Option.Rel r' o' o
  | _, _, .some h => .some (hr _ _ h)
  | _, _, .none => .none

/-- Transitivity of `Option.Rel` (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem optionRel_trans {α β γ : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {r' : β → γ → Prop}
    {r'' : α → γ → Prop} (hr : ∀ a b c, r a b → r' b c → r'' a c) :
    ∀ {o o' o''}, Option.Rel r o o' → Option.Rel r' o' o'' → Option.Rel r'' o o''
  | _, _, _, .some h, .some h' => .some (hr _ _ _ h h')
  | _, _, _, .none, .none => .none

end Rename

open Rename

/-! ## Renamed holders and places (§40, §42) -/

/-- A holder renamed (§40, §42; §49, last paragraph): frames are not renamed. -/
def Holder.ren (π : Ren) : Holder → Holder
  | .frame f => .frame f
  | .place p => .place (π.f p)

/-- A place renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph): parent and owner renamed, `kind` kept. -/
def Place.ren (π : Ren) (pl : Place) : Place := ⟨pl.parent.map π.f, pl.owner.ren π, pl.kind⟩

namespace Rename

/-- Renaming a holder back (§40, §42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Holder.ren_symm (π : Ren) (h : Holder) : (h.ren π).ren π.symm = h := by
  cases h <;> simp [Holder.ren, π.gf]

/-- Renaming holders is injective (§40, §42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Holder.ren_inj (π : Ren) {a b : Holder} : a.ren π = b.ren π ↔ a = b :=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← Holder.ren_symm π a, h, Holder.ren_symm], fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩

/-- Renaming holders twice is renaming by the composition (§40, §42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Holder.ren_comp (π π' : Ren) (h : Holder) : (h.ren π).ren π' = h.ren (π'.comp π) := by
  cases h <;> rfl

/-- A renamed holder is a place exactly when the holder is (§70.1; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Holder.isPlace_ren (π : Ren) (h : Holder) : (h.ren π).isPlace = h.isPlace := by
  cases h <;> rfl

/-- Renaming a place back (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Place.ren_symm (π : Ren) (pl : Place) : (pl.ren π).ren π.symm = pl := by
  obtain ⟨p, o, k⟩ := pl
  simp only [Place.ren, Holder.ren_symm, Option.map_map]
  cases p <;> simp [π.gf]

/-- Renaming places twice is renaming by the composition (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Place.ren_comp (π π' : Ren) (pl : Place) : (pl.ren π).ren π' = pl.ren (π'.comp π) := by
  obtain ⟨p, o, k⟩ := pl
  simp only [Place.ren, Holder.ren_comp, Option.map_map]
  rfl

/-! ## Related authorities, obligations, places and states (§38, §40, §42, §74, §75) -/

/-- Authorities related by the renaming (§42; §49, last paragraph); footprints up to permutation
(§42: a set). -/
structure AuthRel (π α : Ren) (y y' : Authority) : Prop where
  mode : y'.mode = y.mode
  origin : y'.origin = y.origin.map α.f
  footprint : y'.footprint.Perm (y.footprint.map π.f)
  holder : y'.holder = y.holder.ren π
  active : y'.active = y.active

/-- Pinning obligations related by the renaming (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph); identities
kept, leaves up to permutation. -/
structure PinRel (π : Ren) (ob ob' : PinOb) : Prop where
  place : ob'.place = π.f ob.place
  leaves : ob'.leaves.Perm (ob.leaves.map π.f)
  active : ob'.active = ob.active

/-- Place lists related by the renaming (§40; §49, last paragraph); fresh identities fixed. -/
structure PRel (π : Ren) (P P' : List Place) : Prop where
  len : P'.length = P.length
  get : ∀ q, P'[π.f q]? = (P[q]?).map (Place.ren π)
  fix : ∀ q, P.length ≤ q → π.f q = q

/-- States related by place renaming `π` and authority renaming `α` (§38; §49, last paragraph);
footprints, anchors (§44: a set) and pinned leaves up to permutation. -/
structure SRel (π α : Ren) (s s' : S3) : Prop where
  F : s'.F = s.F
  nF : s'.nF = s.nF
  P : PRel π s.P s'.P
  I : ∀ l, s'.I (π.f l) = s.I l
  Alen : s'.A.length = s.A.length
  A : ∀ x, Option.Rel (AuthRel π α) (s.A[x]?) (s'.A[α.f x]?)
  Afix : ∀ x, s.A.length ≤ x → α.f x = x
  D : ∀ q, (s'.D (π.f q)).Perm ((s.D q).map α.f)
  dead : ∀ q, s'.dead (π.f q) = s.dead q
  pins : ∀ o : Nat, Option.Rel (PinRel π) (s.pins[o]?) (s'.pins[o]?)

/-- Parent links go to smaller identities (§49.2; representation of acyclicity, §49 last
paragraph). -/
def DownP (P : List Place) : Prop := ∀ j o, parentOf P j = some o → o < j

/-- Origin links go to smaller identities (§49.5; representation of acyclicity, §49 last
paragraph). -/
def DownA (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ j o, s.org j = some o → o < j

/-- Parent and origin links go to smaller identities (§49.2, §49.5; §49, last paragraph). -/
def Down (s : S3) : Prop := DownP s.P ∧ DownA s

/-- `π` keeps the order of the parts of every place, their positional field order (§63.2; §49,
last paragraph). -/
def SibMono (π : Ren) (P : List Place) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y p, parentOf P x = some p → parentOf P y = some p → x < y → π.f x < π.f y

/-- The simulation invariant (§49, last paragraph; §57): related states, both with downward
links, and `π` keeping field order (§63.2). -/
structure Sim (π α : Ren) (s s' : S3) : Prop where
  rel : SRel π α s s'
  down : Down s
  down' : Down s'
  sib : SibMono π s.P

/-- Owner-accepted hypothesis of 2026-11-06 on `Satisfiable` (§71, §48; §49, last paragraph): it
does not distinguish states equal up to permutation of footprint, anchor and pin-leaf lists
(§42, §44). -/
def KExt (k : K) : Prop :=
  ∀ p sh s t, SRel Ren.id Ren.id s t → k.Satisfiable p sh s → k.Satisfiable p sh t

end Rename

states. -/

/-- A root static is a declared element with no parent (§40, §47). -/
private theorem rootIdx_get {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {j i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx ls)[j]? = some i) : i < ls.length ∧ (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
  have := List.mem_of_getElem? h
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none] at this
  exact this

/-- The parent of a static is an earlier static with the same owner (`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
private theorem statics_parent {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) {i r : Nat}
    (hi : i < statics.length) (hr : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1) = some r) :
    r < i ∧ ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = ((statics.map (·.1))[r]?).bind (·.2.1) := by
  have h1 := (h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))).1
  rw [hr] at h1
  obtain ⟨-, h2, h3⟩ := h1
  exact ⟨by omega, by simpa using h3⟩

/-- The owning static of a static is an earlier static (`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
private theorem statics_owner {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) {i o : Nat}
    (hi : i < statics.length) (ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = some o) : o < i := by
  have h2 := (h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))).2
  rw [ho] at h2
  have := h2.2
  omega

/-- Every static is usable in the initial state (§40, §47): its owners lead to frame 0. -/
private theorem init_usable {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) :
    ∀ n i, i < n → i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i
  | 0, _, hn, _ => absurd hn (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, hn, hi => by
    have hpl := initP_get hi
    cases ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
    | none =>
      exact .frame (f := 0) hpl rfl (by unfold shapeOwner; rw [ho]) (List.mem_singleton_self _)
    | some o =>
      have := statics_owner h hi ho
      exact .place (o := o) hpl rfl (by unfold shapeOwner; rw [ho]) (init_usable h n o (by omega)
        (by omega))

/-- A place of `S3.init statics` is a declared static (§40, §47). -/
private theorem init_lt_of_mem_footprint {statics : Statics} {q l : Nat}
    (h : l ∈ footprint (S3.init statics).P q) : q < statics.length := by
  obtain ⟨hl, -, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h
  rw [initP_len] at hl
  rcases hlq with rfl | hc
  · exact hl
  · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hc) hl

/-- A root static is a root place of the initial state (§40, §47). -/
private theorem init_rootPlace {statics : Statics} {j i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i) : RootPlace (S3.init statics).P i := by
  obtain ⟨hil, hin⟩ := rootIdx_get h
  have hi : i < statics.length := by simpa using hil
  exact ⟨by rw [initP_len]; exact hi,
    by simp only [parentOf, initP_get hi, Option.bind_some]; exact hin⟩

/-- Root authorities of distinct positions are roots of distinct statics (§47: one root authority
per root static). -/
private theorem init_root_inj {statics : Statics} {j j' i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i)
    (h' : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j']? = some i) : j = j' :=
  Frames.getElem?_inj_of_lt ((Frames.range_pairwise_lt _).filter _) h h'

/-- The initial state satisfies `KInv` (§57) and the auxiliaries `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and
`HeldAnchored` (not clauses of §57) for a well-formed statics declaration (`StaticsOK`, §47:
acyclic ownership of statics; §49, ordering of identifiers). -/
theorem init_kinv {statics : Statics} (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    KInv (S3.init statics) ∧ KAux (S3.init statics) ∧ HeldAnchored (S3.init statics) := by
  have hus : ∀ i, i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i :=
    fun i hi => init_usable hst (i + 1) i (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hi
  have hof : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl →
      pl.owner = .frame f → f < (S3.init statics).nF := by
    intro q pl f hq ho
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
    simp only [shapeOwner] at ho
    split at ho
    · cases ho
    · cases ho; exact Nat.zero_lt_one
  have hop : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl →
      pl.owner = .place o → o < (S3.init statics).P.length := by
    intro q pl o hq ho
    obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
    simp only [shapeOwner] at ho
    split at ho
    · rename_i o' ho'
      cases ho
      rw [initP_len]; exact Nat.lt_trans (statics_owner hst hql ho') hql
    · cases ho
  have hw : WF3 (S3.init statics) := {
    frames := ⟨by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init]⟩
    places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
      obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
      obtain ⟨hrq, hown⟩ := statics_parent hst hql hp
      exact ⟨_, initP_get (by omega), hrq, by simp only [shapeOwner, hown], rfl⟩
    owners := ⟨hof, hop, fun _ hq => hq.frameOf⟩
    footprints := fun a x ha l hl => by
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      exact ⟨(mem_footprint.1 hl).1, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.1⟩
    origins := fun b y a hb ho => by
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hb; cases ho
    rootChain := fun a y l ha hl _ => by
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      exact ⟨a, _, i, .inl rfl, ha, rfl, init_rootPlace hi, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2,
        fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
    rootHeld := fun r hr _ => by
      have hrl : r < statics.length := by have := hr.1; rwa [initP_len] at this
      have hpn : ((statics.map (·.1))[r]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
        have := hr.2; simp only [parentOf, initP_get hrl, Option.bind_some] at this; exact this
      have hmem : r ∈ rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)) := by
        simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, List.length_map, hrl, hpn,
          Option.isNone_none, and_self]
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Frames.exists_getElem?_of_mem hmem
      refine ⟨j, ⟨.modify, none, footprint (S3.init statics).P r,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) r, true⟩, _, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, initP_get hrl,
        rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
      simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map, hj]; rfl
    holders := fun a y ha _ => by
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      have hil : i < statics.length := by simpa using (rootIdx_get hi).1
      show HolderLive _ (shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i)
      unfold shapeOwner
      cases ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
      | none => exact List.mem_singleton_self _
      | some o => exact hus o (Nat.lt_trans (statics_owner hst hil ho) hil) }
  have hconv : RootHeldConv (S3.init statics) := fun x z l r hx _ hl hrp hlr => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get hx
    obtain rfl := rootOf_unique hrp (init_rootPlace hi) hlr (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2
    have hil : r < statics.length := by simpa using (rootIdx_get hi).1
    exact ⟨_, initP_get hil, rfl⟩
  have hi1 : I1 (S3.init statics) := fun a b x y p hab ha hb _ _ xp yp _ _ => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
    obtain ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩ := initA_get hb
    have hii : i ≠ i' := fun e => hab (init_root_inj hi (e ▸ hi'))
    exact absurd (rootOf_unique (init_rootPlace hi) (init_rootPlace hi') (mem_footprint.1 xp).2.2
      (mem_footprint.1 yp).2.2) hii
  have hnd : NoDangling (S3.init statics) := fun _ _ _ _ q hq l hl _ =>
    hq (hus q (init_lt_of_mem_footprint hl))
  have haoh : AnchorOrderHeld (S3.init statics) := fun q hq x y hy _ hhq => by
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hy
    have hex : (S3.init statics).effAnchor x = x := by
      have : (S3.init statics).org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy]
      simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none this]
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
    have hf0 : f = 0 := List.mem_singleton.1 hfF
    subst hf0
    have hhq' : shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i = .place q := hhq
    unfold EffAnchorOK
    rw [hex, hy]
    simp only [OptP, hhq', S3.hframe, pframe_iff.2 hf]
    exact hfF
  refine ⟨kInv_of hw ⟨⟨hi1, ?_, fun _ _ x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩, fun _ _ x hx => ?_, hnd⟩ haoh,
    hconv, fun x y q hy _ ho _ _ => ?_⟩
  · intro b y a hb ho
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hb; cases ho
  · cases hx
  · cases hx
  · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hy; exact absurd rfl ho

/-- The `Init` leaves of the initial state are exactly the statics declared `Init` (§47, §59). -/
theorem init_statics (statics : Statics) (l : Nat) :
    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  show (if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then InitSt.init else .uninit) = .init ↔ _
  cases statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-! ## Reachable states (§57) -/

/-- `KInv` (§57) and the auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` (not clauses of §57) hold on every
state reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound` (§80), for well-formed statics
(`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
theorem reachable_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact init_kinv hst
  | step _ h ih =>
    exact ⟨kstep_preserves hdd ih.1 ih.2.2 h, kstep_preserves_kAux ih.1 ih.2.1 h,
      kstep_preserves_heldAnchored ih.1.1 ih.2.2 h⟩
